item_short_desc: Rothco's Hard Shell Forearm Guards, the ultimate solution for protecting your elbows and forearms during rigorous activities. Engineered with a tough exterior made of non-reflective polycarbonate and padded with durable mesh-covered EVA foam, these guards offer unbeatable defense against impacts and abrasions. The protective forearm guards come with adjustable hook and loop closures for a personalized fit and a convenient nylon gear bag for storage. The Hard Shell Forearm Guards come in one size and are sold in pairs.
